scenario: [LNLS.3.3a] — part of a composite key is not an anchor: both schemas key on (site, bay) and the `where` equates `site` alone, so every `bay` under one site matches. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.full_key_anchor`'s `all_true` over the key slots of BOTH sides; an `any` there would compile this.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Device scope logical:
    site: String key
    bay: Int key

schema Reading scope logical:
    site: String key
    bay: Int key
    amount: Int mutable

rule joined:
    Device d
    Reading x where x.site == d.site
->
    log info "x"
